title: "02_expression_clean"
format: html
---

##Load libraries, read the data and drop NAs and Duplicates
```{r}
library(hugene10sttranscriptcluster.db) 
library(tidyverse)                     

# 1. Load and clean expression matrix
expr_clean <- read_tsv("../data/01_exprsdat_load.tsv")
colnames(expr_clean)[1] <- "probeID"

#2. Drop NAs and duplicates
initial <- dim(expr_clean)

expr_clean <- expr_clean |> 
  mutate(probeID = as.character(probeID)) |> 
  distinct(probeID, .keep_all = TRUE) |> 
  drop_na()

final <- dim(expr_clean)
```
As we can see no NAs or duplicates existed in the data frame

##Map probeIDs to ENTREZ IDs

We need to map each of the probe IDs to ENTREZ IDs. to do that we first create a tibble with the entrez IDs and then we join that tibble with the expr data frame. The microarray used Affymetrix Human Gene 1.0 ST Array (HuGene-1_0-st), so we look up into the corresponding annotation package

```{r}
# 2. Query chip's annotation package
probe_map <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  hugene10sttranscriptcluster.db,  
  keys = as.character(expr_clean$probeID),         
  columns = c("ENTREZID","SYMBOL"),
  keytype = "PROBEID"              
) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  rename(probeID = PROBEID, ENTREZ_ID = ENTREZID) |>  #dplyr::because it would use base::rename instead and won't work
  filter(!is.na(ENTREZ_ID)) |> 
  distinct(probeID, .keep_all = TRUE) 

```

##Join ENTREZ IDs data frame to expr data frame
```{r}
# 3. Join Entrez IDs to expression data and collapes probe duplicates to entrez IDs
expr_clean <- expr_clean|> 
  inner_join(probe_map, by = "probeID") |> 
  select(-probeID) |> 
  group_by(ENTREZ_ID, SYMBOL) |> 
  summarise(across(everything(), mean), .groups = "drop")
  
dim(expr_clean)
glimpse(expr_clean[, 1:6])
```

##Save the expr_clean to a tsv file
```{r}
write_tsv(expr_clean, "../data/02_clean_expression.tsv")
```
